assistants.title: Voice assistants
assistants.intro: Log and ask by voice, for example: “Alexa, tell Lotties the baby fell asleep”. Link your Lotties account in the Alexa app first.
assistants.hintOne: You log for one baby, so voice commands use {{name}}.
assistants.hintSeveral: You log for more than one baby: choose the one voice commands log and answer for.

sayBabyName.label: Say my baby's name in answers
sayBabyName.hint: The answer is sent to Amazon (Alexa) or to your AI assistant, so a name ties your child to what you ask. Turn this on only if you want to hear the name.

sayMedicineNames.label: Say the names of my medicines in answers
sayMedicineNames.hint: The answer is sent to Amazon (Alexa) or to your AI assistant, so a medicine name tells them what your child takes. Turn this on only if you want reminders by name.

assistants.saveFailed: This baby can't be used for voice commands. Choose a baby you log for.
assistants.loadFailed: Couldn't load the voice assistant settings.
assistants.privacy: Amazon processes what you say to Alexa. Lotties receives only the command and its values, and sends back the answer Alexa speaks. The answer has no baby name unless you turn on “Say my baby's name in answers” above, and never includes text typed by you or others, such as notes or appointment titles.
assistants.privacyLink: How voice commands use your data (privacy policy)

mcp.title: AI assistants (MCP)
mcp.intro: Connect an AI assistant you choose, such as Claude, to Lotties over MCP. It can then answer questions from your baby's log and, only if you allow it, log sleep, feeds and diapers for you. With several babies it asks which one, or uses the baby chosen above.
mcp.urlHint: Paste this URL in your assistant's connector settings (in Claude: Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector). You then sign in to Lotties and approve what the assistant may do.
mcp.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the URL and copy it.
mcp.privacy: What you share: the company behind the assistant receives the facts it asks for from your baby's log (times, amounts, counts) and handles them under its own terms. It gets your baby's name only if you turn on “Say my baby's name in answers” above. Access is read-only unless you also approve logging. Medications are never shared, and answers are facts from your log, not medical advice.
mcp.revoke: To disconnect an assistant, open Manage connected apps, then Applications, and remove its access.

deleteRequest.siri: Siri asked to delete this entry
deleteRequest.assistant: An AI assistant asked to delete this entry

siri.title: Siri and Shortcuts
siri.intro: Ask Siri, or use the Shortcuts app, to log and ask about your baby with your voice, with the same questions and answers as the Alexa skill (for example "Log a diaper in Lotties", "When was the last feed in Lotties"). Siri signs in to Lotties once, here, and then works like the AI assistants below: it can read your baby's log and, only if you allow it, log events.
siri.connected: Siri is connected on this iPhone.
siri.failed: Could not connect Siri. Try again.
siri.needsInternet: Siri needs an internet connection: nothing is logged while offline. The widget buttons work offline.
siri.revoke: Disconnecting removes the sign-in from this iPhone. You can also revoke it for every device in your account's connected apps.

androidVoice.title: Voice on Android
androidVoice.intro: Log and ask about your baby from the app's shortcuts (touch and hold the Lotties icon, or add one to your home screen), with the same answers as the Alexa skill, shown and spoken aloud. Where Google Assistant supports it, you can also say "Open wet diaper in Lotties". The phone signs in to Lotties once, here, and then works like the AI assistants below: it can read your baby's log and, only if you allow it, log events.
androidVoice.connected: Voice is connected on this phone.
androidVoice.failed: Could not connect voice. Try again.
androidVoice.needsInternet: Voice needs an internet connection: nothing is logged while offline.
androidVoice.revoke: Disconnecting removes the sign-in from this phone. You can also revoke it for every device in your account's connected apps.
